title: He Sounds Just Like New York
description: A challenge mod made in a little over 40 minutes. My prompt was "New York." [ARCHIVED, DON'T PLAY!]
body:
# Adds various New York classics!

**(Extra points for JSchlatt.)**

![Meme](https://i.imgur.com/optV9QA.gif)

## Features:

- **Anti Homeless Bench**

![Render](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/910462d25e6c64831dd68ad1580138ffd6f83ba8.png)

![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9939c4eeb3bdda53544728ffe69333ad72ad13d2.png)

-----

- **Soul Blu-Ray DVD**

![DVD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eacdb1094f58fa0542e48d22a7903c5564ae492a.png)

-----

- **Golden Rat Pizza**
  - **Gives you Regeneration, Absorption, and Health Boost.**

![Pizza](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/194073241362970e5306c159d9f94bc50e96cce1.png)

-----

- **Street Rat**
  - **Spawns in Lush and Dripstone Caves.**

![Flint](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24b9ecc76a8fe26a06ff933b35f84452accdb5d6.png)

-----

- **Villagers gather around the Anti Homeless Benches. They are gangsters. New York gangsters.**

![Profession](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d21b12bc1ba7526fada32476d8ac1bddea54029.png)

![Selling Stuff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92ec6f57393a8341abe920e900b0b67e2e3091bb.png)
